title: Compress Image to 20 KB Online — Free, Best Quality | QuickTiny
desc: Reduce a photo to under 20 KB for signatures and exam application photos. Finds the best quality that fits, keeps proportions, works on many photos at once. No upload, no sign-up.
intro: Need a photo under 20 KB for signatures and exam application photos? Drop it here — the tool finds the highest quality that fits under 20 KB and keeps the proportions. Everything happens in your browser.
about:
Why 20 KB?

Many exam and recruitment portals cap scanned signatures at 10–20 KB and photos at 20–50 KB. At 20 KB the image is scaled to roughly 300–400 px wide so text and faces stay readable.

Steps

  1. The size is already set to 20 KB.
  2. Drop one or more photos (JPG, PNG, WebP).
  3. Download each photo or all of them as a ZIP — every file is guaranteed to be under 20 KB.
faq: Is the result really under 20 KB?
Yes. 20 KB is treated as 20,000 bytes, which is under the limit whether a site counts 1,000 or 1,024 bytes per KB.
Does it work on my phone?
Yes — it runs in mobile browsers, and photos never leave your device.
